description: Starts a randomized self-experiment on one nightly outcome, e.g. 'does no caffeine after noon change my sleep score?'. It PRE-REGISTERS the hypothesis and the analysis plan (stored in the result and the file) and draws the whole schedule up front: each day from the start is an intervention day, a control day, a washout day (the `washout` days after each intervention day, never analysed) or unassigned (a weekday not in `eligible`). Eligible days are paired in order and each pair holds one intervention and one control day in random order, drawn by a seeded generator (the seed is stored; the schedule is never redrawn), so the two arms are exactly balanced; a last unpaired day is dropped. The experiment starts tomorrow unless startDate (today or later, at most 60 days ahead) says otherwise; it needs at least 6 intervention and 6 control days (the least that can ever give a verdict) or it is refused. Only one active (upcoming or running) experiment per outcome metric at a time. Outcome `metric` is the night AFTER each assigned day, one of the per-night values get_baselines and get_tag_effects use: sleepDurationS, sleepScore, hrv, recoveryMorning. Follow it with get_experiment (today's assignment) and log_experiment_day (what really happened), then analyze_experiment after the planned end. Local file ~/.suunto-mcp/experiments.json (SUUNTO_EXPERIMENTS_PATH overrides it); never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials. Output: { saved (summary), experiment: { id, name, intervention, control, metric, days, washout, eligible, startDate, endDate, seed, hypothesis, analysisPlan, schedule: [{ date, arm ('intervention' | 'control' | 'washout' | 'none'), block }], log }, note }. Not read-only (writes the file), not destructive, not idempotent (each call starts another experiment). In demo mode it is kept in memory, and a finished demo experiment is already there.

control.description: What to do on a control day, e.g. 'usual routine'.

days.description: How many calendar days the experiment lasts from its start.

eligible.description: Weekdays that may carry an intervention or control day (default: every day), e.g. ['mon','tue','wed','thu'].

intervention.description: What to do on an intervention day, in plain words.

metric.description: The nightly outcome: sleepDurationS, sleepScore, hrv or recoveryMorning (read for the night after each assigned day).

name.description: A short name, e.g. 'No caffeine after noon'.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default tomorrow; today or later).

washout.description: Days after each intervention day that are left out, to let carry-over pass (default 0).

name: start_experiment
title: Start a randomized self-experiment (pre-registered, schedule drawn up front)
